helperInvocation: NOT authorized before real source-fence installation; install/readback/validate only. Invocation belongs to separately authorized maintenance.
allowedRealSourceRequest: Exactly one request-correlated PutObject canary on the existing reserved absent diagnostic key with IfMatch mismatch and owner guard; no source-object creation/deletion or policy change.
allowedIsolatedOperations: If held request is denied: one separately labeled synthetic late-arrival injection
originalPrincipalProofDecision: NOT discharged by this package. Original generated/manual controls are reviewed for later maintenance; original shared/cleanup safe path remains a separate security decision.
residualRiskAcceptanceRequired: Physical admitted upload may complete late
No fixed CloudTrail delivery/completeness deadline or complete historical coverage
Canary demonstrates exact path/delivery only, not universal arrival census
Unversioned source loses overwritten/deleted historical bodies
Race may show denied rather than late completion; report actual outcome without retry until desired result

retention.policy: No automatic lifecycle/deletion. Keep trail active for continuing logo quarantine; later authorized stop/retirement after exports/reconciliation.
retention.asset: Delete only owned uploaded helper artifact version after Lambda removed; retain local immutable pins and sanitized receipts

cost.expectedBoundedRehearsalUSD: less than 1, estimate not a cap
cost.assumptions: at most 1000 selected data events, 64 KiB synthetic objects, no repeated race, no helper invocations in this package
cost.ongoing: Actual additional CloudTrail events, versioned S3 storage/requests and existing log ingestion continue to accrue; operator owns review

stop: Any unexpected real-source write or adoption
Ambiguous terminal or incomplete event correlation
No automatic write retry, role broadening or real-source cleanup
